articles.title: A decade of Gazette: a streaming broker that doesn’t store data
articles.read_scope: Complete substantive prose, thirteen sections, append/transaction/ownership examples and captions. Images not inspected; snippets not executed.

trigger.text: Historical replay beside a latency-sensitive live stream.

problem.text: Replay and live traffic require different capacity paths.

mechanism.text: Hot replication and immutable fragments share journal offsets; clients can read stored history directly.

limits.text: Single-journal write capacity remains bounded; partition across journals to scale further.

counterexample.text: Live-only consumption may not justify another historical path.

verification.text: Replay across sealed/live seam; assert contiguous committed bytes and bounded live latency.

articles.title: Replica expiration: Limiting temporal filters' resource requirements
articles.read_scope: Complete body and constant-collection appendix, including SQL and update tables; no execution.

trigger.text: Continuously maintained time-filtered views and their state budget.

problem.text: Visible rows omit pending future state.

mechanism.text: Schedule result changes; bound replica execution before discarded future updates become relevant.

limits.text: Retractions consume resources; late records and materialization syntax have explicit limits.

counterexample.text: A far-future row can be invisible yet require pending state.

verification.text: Pin times around admission/expiry, include future and late rows, then measure pending state separately.

unverified_current_claims: Historical observed memory reduction on a new workload

articles.title: Deep Dive Into the RisingWave Stream Processing Engine (Part 3): Trigger Mechanism
articles.read_scope: Complete computation, barriers, injection, watermarks, EOWC and conclusion prose, SQL and captions; diagram pixels not inspected.

trigger.text: Select changing window results versus finalized append-only output.

problem.text: Batch progress and event-time completeness differ.

mechanism.text: Align barriers for incremental flush; wait for watermarks to finalize windows.

limits.text: Late-data exclusion, downstream TTL effects, and connector transaction limits need explicit contracts.

counterexample.text: A max-observed-event watermark may stall on a quiet source.

verification.text: Permute arrival order, advance watermark explicitly, inject late changes, compare update/final output.

current_doc_corrections: Use current /processing/ pages rather than old /docs/current/ routes.
Do not repeat the article's historical experimental label as current feature status.

articles.title: Real Time Streaming Joins With SQL
articles.read_scope: Complete textual body, examples, benefits, change-stream pipeline and conclusion. HTML SQL block empty; embedded images not inspected.

trigger.text: Enrich events or continuously maintain a joined relation.

problem.text: Source changes update joined results; required reference-data time remains a design choice.

mechanism.text: Choose maintained, event-time historical, or processing-time latest-value joins.

limits.text: Regular joins retain state; outer joins can emit nulls before corrections.

counterexample.text: Latest rates can misprice a delayed historical transaction.

verification.text: Change dimensions between event and processing time; assert chosen semantics, corrections and sink representation.

official_crosschecks.title: Broker Concepts
official_crosschecks.read_scope: Complete substantive concepts page: journals, clustering, specifications, fragments/files/index, labels, APIs and gazctl.
official_crosschecks.finding: Serializable journal appends and offset-defined fragments support local/proxied/direct reads. Per-journal append rate stays tied to assigned brokers.

official_crosschecks.title: Temporal filters (time windows)
official_crosschecks.read_scope: Complete substantive page: definition, requirements/restrictions, sliding-window, TTL, periodic-results examples, late events.
official_crosschecks.finding: Virtual-time filters schedule result changes and require pending-retraction resources; grace periods determine admission of late records.

official_crosschecks.title: EXECUTE UNIT TEST
official_crosschecks.read_scope: Complete substantive page, preview warning, runner distinction, AT TIME, mocks, set equality and examples.
official_crosschecks.finding: mz-deploy runs preview tests; AT TIME pins mz_now(). Set comparison alone does not prove a subscription history or resource bound.

official_crosschecks.title: Watermarks
official_crosschecks.read_scope: Complete substantive page: semantics, max-time example, syntax, WITH TTL, generated-column and table/source examples.
official_crosschecks.finding: Watermark-based late admission and table TTL are explicit; TTL cleanup does not delete prior downstream materialized results.

official_crosschecks.title: Emit on window close
official_crosschecks.version: current docs; includes v2.3 change note
official_crosschecks.read_scope: Complete substantive page: update/close policies, required watermark, syntax, output timing, specialized operators.

official_crosschecks.title: Transactions
official_crosschecks.read_scope: Complete substantive page: read-only snapshots/restrictions and CDC-table transaction option.
official_crosschecks.finding: CDC transaction option is native MySQL/PostgreSQL only; more than 4096 changed rows is outside the documented guarantee.

official_crosschecks.title: Joining streaming data
official_crosschecks.read_scope: Complete substantive page, including join-type/state/input-output comparison table.

official_crosschecks.read_scope: Complete prose, historical/latest-value distinctions, exchange-rate tables and SYSTEM_TIME AS OF example; caption only for diagram.
official_crosschecks.finding: Historical lookup uses event time; latest-value lookup uses processing time. Output terminology differs from overview.

official_crosschecks.title: Regular joins
official_crosschecks.read_scope: Targeted join-type examples, Joins that produce nulls section, and multistream CDC update/deletion example; not every displayed payload line counted as prose reading.
official_crosschecks.finding: Outer joins may initially emit nulls, then correct through a change stream when matching input arrives.
